title: Nick Carter, Master Detective
identity_notes: Mutual detective series based on the long-running Street & Smith Nick Carter character. Lon Clark played Nick Carter throughout the radio run. Frozen GRH coverage contains 125 dated recordings from July 6, 1943 through December 25, 1949.

historical_context.title: Nick Carter print-to-radio lineage
historical_context.description: Radio series used the long-established Street & Smith dime-novel/pulp detective character rather than adapting every radio script from a specific print story.

historical_context.title: Long-running Mutual detective series
historical_context.description: Lon Clark starred as Nick Carter throughout the Mutual radio run.

historical_context.title: 1944 fifteen-minute serial experiment
historical_context.description: A short-form weekday serial ran alongside the continuing half-hour series during 1944.
